description: Unified design rules extracted from Figma nodes 3010:2143 (lock), 989:22754 (notif), 3010:2142 (qs). These tokens are the authoritative source. Any hardcoded font/color/radius/spacing value in templates.js or atomics.js should be replaced with a Generator.* helper call that reads this file.

family.system: 'One UI Sans APP VF', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

size._note: UI 텍스트 최소 14px. hero(시계)·기타 스페셜만 예외.

typeScale._description: 5단 공개 스케일. 최소 단계 meta = 14px. legacy typography.size와 대응: meta↔caption/micro, label↔label, body↔body, title↔heading, display↔headline

_sizeTierMap._usage: typography.size 키 → typeScale 키 (기본 line-height·letter-spacing 조회용). hero는 시계 전용.
_sizeTierMap.caption: meta
_sizeTierMap.label: label
_sizeTierMap.title: title
_sizeTierMap.heading: title
_sizeTierMap.headline: display

_rules: 일반 문장·제목(display/title/body/label)·버튼 라벨: 토큰 none(0)만 사용.
스테이터스바 캐리어: statusCarrier. 대문자 섹션 라벨 한 줄만: sectionUppercase.
디스플레이 히어로(hero 112)·날짜 숫자: heroDisplay·date숫자는 none 또는 tight 중 하나만.
padding·margin·gap은 반드시 spacing(xs~4xl) 또는 surface.outerPaddingX/Top 또는 statusBar 패딩과 정확히 일치하는 값만 사용.
임의 픽셀(예: 13px·19px 패딩) 금지. 필요하면 가장 가까운 spacing 토큰으로 반올림.
같은 텍스트 블록 안 인접 줄 gap: spacing[textStackGapKey]. 다른 문단 간: spacing[textParagraphGapKey].

widgetPill._usage: lock screen widgets (battery arc, heart activity)

panel._usage: QS grid panel, notif shade panel

radius._usage: Non-capsule surfaces share 20px (card/widget/dialog/panel/container). Pill/circle tokens + component inline radii reserved for elongated capsules (now-bar, notification strip, voice pill, sliders, toggle circles).

spacing._usage: xs=battery spacing, sm=status bar gap, md=toggle gap, base=notif flex gap, lg=status/time gap, xl=now-bar gap, xxl=card padding, 3xl=QS outer padding, 4xl=section gap

statusBar._usage: same header structure on QS, Notif, Dialog. Lock is slightly different (51h, padding top-only) because it has no outer grid padding.

wallpaper._usage: each surface has a wallpaper PNG at z=0, optional rgba(0,0,0,scrimAlpha) scrim for focal dialogs
